title: Mother Holding Baby, California Stucco Yard - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A stylish young mother poses proudly on a grassy lawn under bright sunshine, cradling her infant child. She is dressed in typical 1940s wartime or immediate post-war casual fashion, featuring wide-leg palazzo trousers, a collared sweater, white spectator shoes, and an upswept pompadour/victory roll hairstyle. Behind her is a stucco home marked with the street number 4443 1/2, neatly trimmed hedges, and a towering evergreen cypress tree.
